definition.name: list_prometheus_metric_metadata
definition.description: List Prometheus metric metadata. Returns metadata about metrics currently scraped from targets. Note: This endpoint is experimental.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

limit.description: The maximum number of metrics to return

limitPerMetric.description: The maximum number of metrics to return per metric
